finding: 14m is a strict observed safe lower bound, not an operating cap. The prior 14m close had 88s overshoot and sparse active-work evidence, so 16m should test a reasoning-heavy profile while preserving explicit close reserve rather than interpreting overshoot as free safety margin.
bounded_implication: A 16m clean pass can advance the exploratory lower bound; it cannot validate a production cap without repeated near-cap passes across representative profiles.
